Advisory reading of one immutable LT Verdict analysis (analysis_id 746bfa23117c842e696c98ae1b348a4f3e4454b44edb6d3dce5f5ea68719dd0d, run jmeter_jtl_csv-328e8dba8cff8a5ff8b37906a24aaeec32cf2c83f454d364a422fefe7267e183). The deterministic outcome is preserved exactly and is not altered by this advice: run_validity VALID; policy_verdict NO_POLICY; analysis_coverage INCOMPLETE with reasons CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED and CAPACITY_STAGE_NOT_VERIFIED; capacity bound_type INDETERMINATE with lower_inclusive null, upper_exclusive null, capacity_knee null (knee_reason KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED), load_axis users, unit count.

One stage was evaluated: d16-cpu-limited-20users, target 20 with target_tolerance_ratio 0.1, achieved 20 (achieved_statistic p05_10s), observed_min 20, observed_max 20, complete_bins 30 of expected_bins 30, verdict INDETERMINATE, verified_bound_load null, reason CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED. The cause recorded for that reason is the diagnostic generator guard generator-cpu-throttle-ratio (operator gt, threshold 0.2, unit ratio), status FAIL, effect diagnostic. The matching series shows median 1, mean 0.8610030984778667, q25 0.955188679245, min 0.05, max 1 over 30 observed cells with 0 missing, and one resource_threshold_violation finding covers 27 cells from 1790627160000 to 1790627430000 with observed_min 0.395833333333 and observed_max 1.

Window policy summary for 1790627160000-1790627460000 reports business_verdict PASS, resource_verdict NO_POLICY, verdict PASS. The only policy_check present is overall-errors on error_rate_ratio (observed 0/38842, operator lte, threshold 0.01, PASS). The overall metric summary reports sample_count 47396 with error_count 0 and latency_ms p50 103 / p95 299 / p99 600 / max 1299; all six per-transaction summaries also report error_count 0. Resource summaries exist for frontend, checkoutservice and paymentservice cpu_cores and memory_bytes, but no policy check references them.

Two points govern the interpretation. First, NO_POLICY stays NO_POLICY: neither the healthy business window, nor a rerun, nor fixing the load generator converts it to PASS - only a configured policy or required capacity yields PASS or FAIL. Second, the failed guard is diagnostic by contract, so it makes its stage unusable for a product bound and never creates an upper bound at 20 users; the product remedy is a rerun with a generator that is not saturated. clock_alignment is not_verified_by_core, so no lead/lag or temporal causal ordering between throttling, resource use and latency is supportable. All explanations below are hypotheses paired with bounded checks limited to operator actions: rerun, inspect data, configure policy, verify clocks.

hypotheses.observation: analysis-result.json#/evidence/16 reports rule_id generator-cpu-throttle-ratio, operator gt, threshold "0.2", unit ratio, status FAIL, effect diagnostic, window_id d16-cpu-limited-20users, reason null. The matching series summary analysis-result.json#/evidence/12 (entity jmeter-generator, role generator, metric cfs_throttled_period_ratio, interval_mean, 30 observed cells of 30 expected, 0 missing, longest_gap_cells 0) shows median 1, mean 0.8610030984778666666666666666666667, q05 0.1000408288253, q25 0.955188679245, q75 1, q95 1, min 0.05, max 1, mad 0, slope_per_second -0.002158603633201067853170189098998888. analysis-result.json#/findings/0 records a resource_threshold_violation for the same rule with cell_count 27, observed_min 0.395833333333, observed_max 1, from_epoch_ms 1790627160000, to_epoch_ms 1790627430000. The stage in analysis-result.json#/capacity_summary carries reason CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED and verdict INDETERMINATE.
hypotheses.possible_explanation: Hypothesis: the JMeter generator host was CPU-constrained (CFS throttled) for most cells of the evaluation window, so its throttle ratio exceeded the 0.2 diagnostic threshold. Because this rule is diagnostic by contract, the FAIL renders the stage unusable for a product capacity bound; it does not by itself indicate a defect in the system under test, and it does not create an upper bound. Whether throttling affected delivered load or observed latency is not established by this evidence.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Rerun the d16-cpu-limited-20users stage with a generator that is not saturated - raise the generator CPU allocation/quota, lower per-generator thread count, or spread the same nominal load across more generator hosts - leaving the rule effect as diagnostic. Then confirm that generator-cpu-throttle-ratio stays at or below 0.2 in every cell and that CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED clears from the stage reasons. Separately, inspect the per-cell series to identify which cells were compliant, since the series min 0.05 is below the finding's observed_min 0.395833333333.

hypotheses.possible_explanation: Hypothesis: no latency, throughput or system-resource policy and no required capacity were configured for this run, so the run-level verdict cannot resolve to PASS or FAIL and is reported as NO_POLICY. The window-level business PASS reflects only the single configured error-rate rule inside that window and does not extend to the run-level verdict; a missing policy is not a pass.
hypotheses.recommended_check: Configure the intended policy set - for example latency percentile thresholds for the transactions of interest and resource rules for frontend, checkoutservice and paymentservice - and/or a required capacity on the users load axis, then rerun the analysis. Verify afterwards that resource_verdict is no longer NO_POLICY. Note that a rerun, a healthy business window, or fixing the load generator alone will not turn NO_POLICY into PASS.

hypotheses.possible_explanation: Hypothesis: with a single load level whose only stage is unverified because of the failed diagnostic generator guard, no lower or upper bound can be derived, so verified_bound_load, lower_inclusive and upper_exclusive remain null and coverage stays INCOMPLETE. The null knee is a fixed product limitation (KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED) rather than a property of this run; bounds derive from stages with verified product outcomes independently of any knee.
hypotheses.recommended_check: After generator saturation is resolved, plan and execute a multi-stage ramp across the user levels of interest, each stage with an explicit target and tolerance and enough bins to complete, then rerun the capacity analysis and check whether stage verdicts become verified and whether lower_inclusive / upper_exclusive are populated. Do not read the failed guard as an upper bound at 20 users, and do not plan work around capacity_knee.

recommendations.action: Report the deterministic verdict as recorded - run_validity VALID, policy_verdict NO_POLICY, coverage INCOMPLETE, capacity INDETERMINATE - and present the window verdict PASS as scoped to the configured error-rate rule within 1790627160000 to 1790627460000 only.

recommendations.action: When comparing counts or rates, restrict each comparison to one scope and one window: keep the policy-window denominator 38842, the overall denominator 47396, the per-transaction denominators near 7,900 and the repeated throughput denominator 358231 in separate columns, and recompute on a common scope and window if a comparison is required.

recommendations.action: If tails or specific transactions need investigation, inspect the raw JTL samples for the relevant labels restricted to the evaluation window rather than drawing conclusions from summary percentiles.
recommendations.rationale: Summary percentiles (for example overall p99 600 ms, home p99 806 ms, checkout p99 695 ms, reset cart p50 4 ms) are descriptive aggregates with no configured threshold, so they cannot support PASS or FAIL statements; sample-level inspection is the bounded way to examine them.

caveats: This advice does not change the deterministic verdict: run_validity VALID, policy_verdict NO_POLICY, analysis_coverage INCOMPLETE with reasons CAPACITY_GUARD_FAILED and CAPACITY_STAGE_NOT_VERIFIED, capacity bound_type INDETERMINATE with lower_inclusive null, upper_exclusive null, and verified_bound_load null for the only stage.

capacity_knee is null with knee_reason KNEE_DETECTOR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. That is a fixed limitation of the product, not a defect of this run and not an operator action item; capacity bounds derive from stages with verified product outcomes independently of any knee.

The rule generator-cpu-throttle-ratio has effect diagnostic. Its FAIL makes the stage unusable for a product bound and does not create an upper bound at 20 users; changing its effect to binding, SLA or enforcing is not a remedy.

Zero errors and a passing error-rate rule do not prove the absence of a problem, adequate capacity, or acceptable latency.

The flat jmeter_active_threads series (20 in every statistic, sample_standard_deviation 0, slope_per_second 0) does not by itself prove that delivered load, request issue rate or system behaviour were stable; it reports configured concurrency only.

Low absolute cpu_cores and memory_bytes values for frontend, checkoutservice and paymentservice do not establish spare capacity, because no limits or thresholds for these entities appear in the evidence and resource_verdict is NO_POLICY.

clock_alignment is not_verified_by_core, so no lead/lag ordering or temporal causal relationship between generator throttling, resource usage and transaction latency can be inferred from this evidence.

Counts and rates are comparable only within the same scope and window: the policy-window denominator 38842, the overall denominator 47396, the per-transaction denominators near 7,900, and the repeated throughput denominator 358231 measure different scopes and windows and are not evidence of inconsistency or data loss. The unit of the throughput denominator is not stated in the referenced fields, so no duration is derived from it here.

Only one load level was evaluated (target 20 users, target_tolerance_ratio 0.1) in a single run with no replication; nothing in this evidence describes behaviour at other load levels or run-to-run variance.

Resource series use interval_mean aggregation over 30 cells covering 1790627160000 to 1790627460000, inside a run spanning 1790627156282 to 1790627514513 and a snapshot span of 1790627090000 to 1790627580000. Sub-cell peaks and time outside the evaluation window are not covered by the policy checks.

window_policy_summary verdict PASS is scoped to that window and coexists with resource_verdict NO_POLICY; a missing policy is not a pass, and NO_POLICY persists until a policy or required capacity is configured.

No confidence percentages, effect sizes or causal attributions are asserted; every explanation above is a hypothesis paired with a bounded check limited to operator actions (rerun, inspect data, configure policy, verify clocks).
